scope: Proposition 7.5 of the manuscript “A translational tile with no fully periodic tiling in dimension three” (preprints/A-translational-tile-with-no-fully-periodic-tiling-in-dimension-three-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 155 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 195ccaae8617ea5d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 24. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The Euclidean tile Ω has no almost-everywhere translational tiling whose transla- tion set is invariant under a full-rank lattice in R3.
